title: The Bakery of Maple Hollow
author: J. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Ines Oyelaran, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
